title: HostProject Config: editor auto-regenerates DefaultEngine.ini/DefaultInput.ini
description: Opening HostProject in editor re-creates [AndroidFileServerRuntimeSettings] with per-machine SecurityToken in DefaultEngine.ini, and rewrites DefaultInput.ini. Decide: (a) gitignore both, (b) commit baselines without machine-specific tokens, or (c) split into Default*.ini (committed) + Local*.ini (ignored).
